surface_mechanism_description: Desorption of molecular species containing Hf and Al result from dissociation processes in the metastable Hf–Al oxide structures. However, different from Hf/Zr oxides and silicates this dissociation cannot be accounted by SiO desorption from the interfacial region.
evidence: Desorption of molecular species containing Hf and Al result from dissociation processes in the metastable Hf–Al oxide structures. However, different from Hf/Zr oxides and silicates this dissociation cannot be accounted by SiO desorption from the interfacial region.
